description: This file defines an interface for an in-memory stream queue grain within the Orleans framework, specifying methods for enqueuing and dequeuing messages.

classes.name: IMemoryStreamQueueGrain
classes.description: Interface for in-memory stream queue grain, defining methods for enqueuing and dequeuing messages.

methods.name: Enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a MemoryMessageData event into the stream queue.

methods.name: Dequeue
methods.description: Dequeues up to maxCount MemoryMessageData events from the stream queue.
